item.title: Warm Lo-Fi Music Bed

turns.text: Make me a 10-second lo-fi hip-hop music bed, warm and relaxed. No vocals.

item.tests: Checks whether the delivered music matches the stated mood, genre and duration without unnecessary clarification.

answer_sheet.Vocals or language: Instrumental only; no vocals or spoken words.

must_haves: One playable music audio file is delivered.
The audio lasts 10 seconds, within 0.1 second.
The music has a recognizable laid-back hip-hop beat and mellow lo-fi texture.
The overall mood is warm and relaxed rather than tense or high-energy.
No singing or spoken words are audible.

turns.text: Could you make me a little music bed? I’ve been wanting something like this for a while, but I always end up overthinking how to describe it. What I mean is lo-fi hip-hop, and it should be 10 seconds long. I want it to feel warm and relaxed. Please keep it instrumental, with no vocals.

dialog.agent:
I can help with a warm, relaxed lo-fi hip-hop bed—soft keys, mellow bass, dusty drums, and no vocals.

One limitation: Magic Hour’s music generator has a **15-second minimum**, so it can’t directly make a 10-second track. Would you like me to generate 15 seconds that you can trim to 10?
dialog.why: It asks the user to choose whether a 15-second track they can trim to 10 seconds would work, and waits for an answer.
dialog.user: Yes, go ahead and generate 15 seconds so I can trim it down to the 10 seconds I need. The instrumentation is your call, as long as it stays warm, relaxed, and completely instrumental. I’m looking for one standalone audio file in the end.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the generation because your account has insufficient credits. **No audio file was created.**

The 15-second instrumental costs **15 credits**. Once you have enough credits, I can retry the warm, relaxed lo-fi bed with soft keys, mellow bass, and dusty drums—completely vocal-free, as one standalone audio file.

approvals.name: generate_music

style.prompt: A warm, relaxed lo-fi hip-hop instrumental music bed. Soft Rhodes electric piano playing mellow jazzy chords, rounded warm bass, understated dusty hip-hop drums with gentle swing, subtle vinyl texture. Cozy, calm, unhurried, intimate atmosphere. Simple consistent groove around 75 BPM, restrained dynamics, no dramatic changes or long intro, suitable as background music. Establish the groove immediately so a clean 10-second excerpt can be trimmed from this 15-second standalone track. Completely instrumental: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no humming, no vocal samples.
